name: Disposable development QA — no release signing or deployment

steps.name: Materialize and verify exact candidate source
Build API contracts and install development test browser
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; build_root="$RUNNER_TEMP/lunchlineup-source-$CI_RUN_ID/build"; cd "$build_root"; npm run build --workspace @lunchlineup/api-contract; npx playwright install chromium

steps.name: Canonical beta release-image build
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; source_context="$RUNNER_TEMP/lunchlineup-source-$CI_RUN_ID/source-context.json"; build_root="$RUNNER_TEMP/lunchlineup-source-$CI_RUN_ID/build"; test -f "$source_context"; test -d "$build_root"; bash "$build_root/scripts/run-internal-beta-release-qualification.sh" --source-context "$source_context" --stage release-image-build

steps.name: Release stack health
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; source_context="$RUNNER_TEMP/lunchlineup-source-$CI_RUN_ID/source-context.json"; build_root="$RUNNER_TEMP/lunchlineup-source-$CI_RUN_ID/build"; test -f "$source_context"; test -d "$build_root"; bash "$build_root/scripts/run-internal-beta-release-qualification.sh" --source-context "$source_context" --stage release-stack-health

steps.name: DB-backed Playwright
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; source_context="$RUNNER_TEMP/lunchlineup-source-$CI_RUN_ID/source-context.json"; build_root="$RUNNER_TEMP/lunchlineup-source-$CI_RUN_ID/build"; test -f "$source_context"; test -d "$build_root"; bash "$build_root/scripts/run-internal-beta-release-qualification.sh" --source-context "$source_context" --stage fullstack-playwright
